title: A Orchard for the Songbook
author: Bram Nakamura
blurb: Mirabel Nystrom, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
